﻿# Tidio
> Tidio is a customer support software suite comprising live chat, chatbot, AI chatbot (AI agent), help desk, and ticketing features. Tidio integrates with websites, ecommerce platforms (such as Shopify and WooCommerce), communications channels (such as Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp), and other tools to provide automated, enhanced customer service.
Learn more about the Tidio customer service platform:
## About Tidio
- [Tidio Homepage](https://www.tidio.com/)
- [About Tidio](https://www.tidio.com/about/): Learn about Tidio, the B2B SaaS company behind customer service software.
 - [About Lyro](https://www.tidio.com/blog/lyro-conversational-ai/): Meet Lyro, the AI agent for customer service
- [Tidio Pricing](https://www.tidio.com/pricing/): See how much Tidio costs.
 - [Tidio Premium Plans](https://www.tidio.com/tidio-premium/): Find out more about Tidio Premium.

## Features
- [All Features Overview](https://www.tidio.com/features/)
### Core Features 
- [Lyro](https://www.tidio.com/ai-agent/): AI agent for customer service and conversational AI chatbot
- [Flows](https://www.tidio.com/flows/): Automation and rule-based chatbot builder
- [Help Desk](https://www.tidio.com/help-desk/): Help desk software
- [Live Chat](https://www.tidio.com/live-chat/): Live chat software for websites
- [Ticketing System](https://www.tidio.com/ticketing/)

Lyro AI Agent
 
Reclaim up to 67% of your team's time by answering common questions and performing recurring tasks with a truly conversational AI.
 
 
Learn more about Lyro AI Agent
chevron_right
 
 
add_task
 
Lyro Smart Actions
 
Lyro AI Agent can handle tasks—like order updates or lead qualification—without human assistance. It integrates with your external systems to take real-time action.
category_search
Product recommendations
Lyro connects to your store inventory. It pulls your entire product catalog in real-time to provide accurate, helpful recommendations based on what you actually sell.
mail
AI-driven email resolutions
Lyro AI scans incoming emails and solves common problems in seconds, giving your team more time to focus on high-priority tasks.
 
rule_settings
Simple, configurable setup
Add Lyro AI Agent to your website with a few clicks. Share links to your support content to feed it with your data, and the AI is good to go.
 
table
Data-backed answers
Lyro AI Agent answers customers using only your support knowledge to minimize hallucinations.
translate
Multilanguage
Lyro AI Agent uses your support content to answer customers in dozens of languages, including English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, and German.
responsive_layout
Multichannel
Lyro AI Agent answers customers on all your live communication channels - live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger.
prompt_suggestion
Smart redirections
Lyro AI Agent redirects customers who ask for information outside its knowledge to your support department.
face
Human-like conversations
Lyro AI Agent understands context and asks clarifying questions when necessary, making the conversations feel natural.
analytics
Analytics
Understand how the audience interacts with your support system.
timelapse
Time saved calculator

Frequently Asked Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is a Conversation?
 
 
 
 
 
Conversation is any live chat, ticket, email or social media channel conversation. A visitor, operator or an automated flow may initiate a conversation.
 
Remember that not all conversations are counted as “Billable conversations”
 
What is a “Billable conversation”?
"Billable conversation" refers to any live chat, ticket, email or social media channel conversation that includes a message from a human agent (you). Unanswered messages initiated by visitors/customers are not counted, ensuring you're billed only for relevant interactions.
 
Responses from Flows and Lyro AI Agent are not counted as ‘agent replies’.
Will I pay for unwanted conversations?
No. A conversation is only billed as a Billable conversation once you reply using Tidio or proactively initiate a conversation with your visitor. If you don’t respond to a customer conversation – if it’s spam or simply a message that doesn’t require a reply – the conversation won’t count toward your monthly limit.
Will I pay for multiple messages within one conversation?
A conversation that receives a response by a human agent or is initiated by a human agent will only be counted as one Billable conversation regardless of how many messages are sent or received on the thread.
How does the free trial work?
During the free 7-day trial, you can test all Tidio features and plans and see how to improve customer service and accelerate sales. You don’t need to provide us with your credit card information to access the free trial.
 
At the end of the trial, your account will automatically be downgraded to the Free plan unless you upgrade your subscription to
